title: Budget Efficiency Index
scenario: Calculate the index: (Total Budget) / (Total Days Duration * Number of Employees). Return 'project_id' and 'efficiency_index'.
tableSchema: projects (project_id INT, start_date DATE, end_date DATE, budget INT), employees (employee_id INT, project_id INT, role VARCHAR, salary INT)
hint: Date difference calculation multiplied by employee count.
correctQuery: SELECT p.project_id, p.budget::NUMERIC / (NULLIF((p.end_date - p.start_date), 0) * COUNT(e.employee_id)) AS efficiency_index FROM projects p JOIN employees e ON p.project_id = e.project_id GROUP BY p.project_id, p.budget, p.end_date, p.start_date;
